These signals are then fed into GSI’s Bayesian inference engine to generate predictive models. The GSE layer consumes these models to update its internal state, enabling autonomous operation. The event taxonomy \mathcal{T} ensures consistency in how these signals are interpreted, while the privacy gate \Pi enforces compliance. Failure modes include signal degradation when \mathcal{A} is under-sampled, or data leakage when \Pi is bypassed. The system's robustness depends on closed-loop validation of event shapes and rollback mechanisms.
